name: Gun Ball
desc:
🔫 In this fast paced game, use your focus and timing to shoot & deflect a homing energy ball. Unlock new abilities, collect unique guns, and show off your kill effects! 

🎯 Become the Sharpest Shooter or play casually, which do you choose? 

📱 Play on any device! 

🎮 CONTROLS: 
BLOCK - F/UI Button/Left Click 
ABILITY - E/UI Button/Right Click (Settings) 
SHIFTLOCK - Shift/UI button
